title: Three.js
summary: Dark 3D scenes and backdrops: silhouettes in fog, rooms lit by one failing source, a moon behind cloud. Everything is nearly black with a single cold (or one warm) light, and the theme's vignette, grain and lamp dips are laid over the canvas so 3D matches the 2D pieces. Use them as a shot's visual or as the background behind a title.

items.name: Fog forest
items.description: Bare black trees standing in rows that fade into cold blue mist, a pale moon behind them, the camera creeping forward. Loops.

items.name: Corridor
items.description: A long dark corridor of doors with failing lights; the camera creeps toward the far end.

items.name: Door ajar
items.description: A door opening very slowly on a lit space beyond; a wedge of cold light spreads across the floor, then the light fails.

items.name: House on the hill
items.description: A house in silhouette against a cold sky with one unsteady lit window, mist sliding past in layers. Loops.

items.name: Hanging bulb
items.description: A bare bulb swinging on its wire in an empty room, its light sliding over a chair and boxes and flickering. Loops.

items.name: Dust in the light
items.description: A shaft of cold light through a barred window with dust turning slowly inside it. A quiet backdrop. Loops.

items.name: Moon and cloud
items.description: A full moon smothered and released by torn drifting cloud above black treetops. A backdrop for titles. Loops.
